aciklama: Bölüm 2 görsellerinin üretim istemleri ve kaydı. Üslup ve yasaklar b10.json'daki ile aynı (u01-d); yalnız dönem ve mekân 570 civarı Yemen ve Hicaz.

uslup.istem: Flat-shape illustration for a documentary motion comic in a paper cut-out style: layered flat shapes with clear depth planes, each plane like a sheet of textured paper with a soft shadow beneath it. Muted, low-saturation earth palette: sand, ochre, raw umber, warm grey stone; deep indigo for night, soft apricot for dawn and dusk. Gentle atmospheric haze, clean readable silhouettes, calm and respectful mood. Setting: Arabia around 570 CE — Yemen (San'a) and the Hijaz desert road to Mecca; Mecca is a narrow valley among bare, rocky, almost treeless mountains with small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone. Cinematic 16:9 framing.

referans.not: u01-d, Erdem seçti (2026-11-13). Her üretime image_references olarak verilir; yalnız üslup ve palet için, kompozisyon için değil.

uslup.yasaklar: No minarets, no domes, no crescents, no arches, no tiles, no Ottoman or modern architecture, no modern Masjid al-Haram. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. Ordinary people may show their faces, drawn simply in the same flat paper cut-out style, dignified, not photorealistic. The Prophet Muhammad appears only when the prompt asks for him, and then only as a tall, dignified figure entirely covered in soft warm golden-white light, wearing a green turban; no face, skin, hands or body detail visible inside the light. His wives, children, parents and wet nurse never show a face: only from behind, as distant silhouettes, or as hands and fabric details. No other prophet in any form: no figure, silhouette, shadow, hand or foot, only a soft warm light. No angels. No blood.
uslup.katman_kurali: Katmanlar ayrı üretilir. Gök katmanı hariç her katman düz, tek renk #00B140 (yeşil perde) zemin üzerinde istenir; zemin sonra `tools/gorsel_katman.py` ile silinip şeffaf WebP yapılır. Konu yeşil içeriyorsa (ör. s06'daki yeşil temel taşları) zemin mavi perde #0047BB istenir ve betik `--mavi` ile çalıştırılır; gök `--opak` ile. Görsel 16:9 kadrajdan her yöne %10 taşacak genişlikte düşünülür; ana öğe alt %25'e (altyazı alanı) düşmez.
uslup.yesil_perde_eki: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green background (#00B140), no shadows on the background, no green tint on the subject.
bilincli_olarak_cizilmeyenler: San'a kilisesinin (Kulleys) mimarisi: kaynakta yalnız 'benzeri görülmemiş' deniyor; sade, görkemli taş yapı, haç/kubbe/yazı yok.
Ordunun silah ve donanımı, Habeş askerlerinin kıyafeti: kaynakta yok; ayrıntısız, küçük figürler.
Kuşların rengi: İbn Hişâm yalnız 'denizden, hatâtîf (kırlangıç) ve belesân benzeri' der; sade koyu biçimler.
Kan, yaralanma, ölü beden, filin dövülmesi: çizilmez.
Kâbe: Abdülmuttalib dönemi, çatısız alçak Kâbe (kabe-alcak, b01 ile aynı).

istemler.istem: Wide view of an ancient highland town in Yemen around 570 CE: plain houses of stone and mudbrick set against bare mountains, drawn simply without distinctive architecture. No people in focus, no minarets, no domes. Fills the lower two thirds of the frame; everything above the rooftops and mountains is flat chroma green (#00B140) so the sky layer shows through.
istemler.not: San'a; kaynakta şehir tarifi yok, yalnız dönem mimarisi. Ufkun üstü perde.

istemler.konu: In San'a, Abraha sits calmly on his throne in a plain open stone courtyard; the same throne as in the attached throne reference: a sturdy wooden throne with a tall arched back upholstered in deep red cloth, thick square wooden armrests, a red seat cloth with a broad golden-yellow border hanging over the front. The throne stands on the paved ground of the courtyard, its legs and Abraha's feet clearly resting on the paving; behind him a plain stone wall, and beyond it simple flat-roofed stone and mudbrick houses and bare mountains under a clear day sky.

A plain wooden door leaf in the doorway carries a plain iron ring. Abdul-Muttalib stands at the door holding the iron ring with one hand and raising the other hand in prayer; a few men of Quraysh stand quietly behind him. Behind the sanctuary, the bare mountains of Mecca, where tiny distant groups of people are climbing the slopes.
